By contrast, the 1-week horizon has wider intervals, as short-term variability compounds and external influences may begin to play a larger role. This uncertainty accounts for the inherent randomness in the system and the limitations of your data model.

Such tail risks are difficult to quantify with precision and might not be fully captured within the 90% confidence bounds presented.
